annotations.text:
Structural pass — built on the repo's own tokens (app/globals.css), not a new aesthetic.
Re-skin against your style screenshots when they land.

Same row, three readers: one open item renders as the parent's task, the coach's gap, and the league's risk.

Framing rule for this screen: it names what is unsettled for THIS EVENT.

No response rates, no per-family history, no ordering families worst-first. Roster order only. Access problems are labelled league-owned so silence is never read as a parent ignoring the coach.
